checklist_items.1.1: A new label row shows two textboxes. The key textbox's accessible name is the key label, its placeholder is that label, it is required, its value is empty, it has no unit, and its maximum length is 128. The value textbox's accessible name is the value label, its placeholder is that label, it is not required, its value is empty, it has no unit, and its maximum length is 256. Both stay visible and the row has no other field. Reading them sends no request. The save request's only field is labels, and the independent GET persists that labels map
checklist_items.1.2: The first open is not loading and Save is enabled. The new key and value are empty, and the dialog has no secret field. An empty key shows the field error and sends no request. After team=alpha is saved, reopening the dialog shows that key and that value in full, and the dialog still has no secret field
checklist_items.1.7: Submitting a label with only the required key pool and the value left empty sends PUT to that node's labels path with body {"labels":{"pool":""}} and the response is 200. The list row shows pool=. The node detail shows pool=. After refresh the list still shows pool= and the independent GET returns {"pool":""}
checklist_items.1.8: The add-label control is one dashed button. Filling the required key team and the optional value alpha sends PUT to that node's labels path with body {"labels":{"team":"alpha"}} and the response is 200. The list row shows team=alpha. After refresh the list still shows team=alpha and the independent GET returns {"team":"alpha"}. Leaving the optional value empty and filling only the required key pool sends PUT with body {"labels":{"pool":""}} and the response is 200. The list row shows pool=. The node detail shows pool=. After refresh the list still shows pool= and the independent GET returns {"pool":""}.
checklist_items.1.9: While the label PUT is held the footer Save stays loading and a second click sends no further save. The later 200 is the only stored label change
checklist_items.1.10: The 502 keeps the labels dialog and the team and alpha draft, shows the server reason, and the independent node GET keeps empty labels. The retry 200 matches the reloaded row
checklist_items.1.11: Cancel, the close button, Escape, and a mask click each close the node labels dialog after the key team and the value draft are typed. None of those dismissals sends a label PUT. The independent GET stays {}
checklist_items.1.12: Changing only the saved value from alpha to beta keeps the key team. The save returns 200 with body {"labels":{"team":"beta"}} and the independent GET returns that map. The node name and server url stay. The label dialog has no switch. Clearing that value keeps the key team. The save returns 200 with body {"labels":{"team":""}} and the independent GET returns {"team":""}. The node name and server url stay. Restoring the value to alpha keeps the key team. Adding site=east keeps team=alpha. Changing only that key from site to zone keeps the value east and team=alpha. Removing that row leaves team=alpha. Each of those saves returns 200, each independent GET matches the saved map, and the node name and server url stay. The open label row is one baseline-aligned space.
checklist_items.1.13: While the label dialog is open on team=alpha, another session's PUT of {labels:{room:east}} returns 200 and the independent GET is {room:east}. The dialog still shows team and alpha. Saving that draft returns 200 with body {labels:{team:alpha}}, the dialog closes, and the independent GET returns {team:alpha}. There is no conflict status. A node deleted while a new label draft is open makes that save return 404 with body {labels:{gone:1}}, the dialog stays open and shows the save failure, cancel sends no further save, and the independent GET stays 404.
checklist_items.1.14: Refresh and independent GET preserve the saved label
checklist_items.1.15: Tab from the key field reaches the value field. Save can be focused. Enter in the empty key sends no label PUT and leaves the key empty. Enter in the filled key pool and value edge sends no label PUT and leaves both values. Enter on Save with an empty key shows the key-required error, marks the key invalid, and sends no label PUT. At 1440×900 the key, value, Save, and Cancel each stay inside the viewport, and the key and the value do not overlap Save or Cancel.
checklist_items.2.2: An empty label key shows the field error and sends no request. A whitespace-only key and a key with surrounding spaces are submitted unchanged, the server rejects both, and the independent GET stays empty. An empty value, a whitespace-only value, and a value with surrounding spaces are each saved as typed. The request body and the independent GET keep those characters. The key is not trimmed into acceptance and the value is not trimmed
checklist_items.2.3: The label value's shortest stored value is empty, and nothing is shorter. 256 ASCII characters are 256 bytes and save; the control stops at 256. A direct PUT of 257 bytes returns NODE_LABELS_INVALID and the independent GET keeps the 256-byte value. 85 Chinese characters are 255 bytes and save. 86 Chinese characters remain in the control, the save returns NODE_LABELS_INVALID, and the independent GET keeps the 85-character value, so the limit counts bytes. The label key's shortest value is one character. Empty is one shorter: the field error shows and no request is sent. 128 ASCII characters are 128 bytes and save; the control stops at 128. A direct PUT of 129 bytes returns NODE_LABELS_INVALID and the independent GET keeps the 128-byte key. The key grammar is single-byte, so its character count and its byte count are the same
checklist_items.2.4: A reserved gpuworks.ai/ key (a product-forbidden character/value class) is rejected by the real server, the modal and stored labels stay unchanged, and the corrected save succeeds
checklist_items.2.6: The label value accepts a pasted 粘A1., a keyboard clear back to empty, and keyboard editing back to alpha. Paste, clear and typing send no request. Pasting text that contains a newline leaves no newline in the control. A direct PUT of a value that contains a newline returns NODE_LABELS_INVALID and the independent GET stays team=alpha. Saving the keyboard-typed alpha and reopening the dialog shows alpha
checklist_items.2.5: Label writes are constrained by the platform rather than by name uniqueness: this product defines no uniqueness rule for a label name or a node name - a taken-name error exists for networks and storages but nothing on either the node or the label store - so the duplicate-name conflict the item offers as its example has no object here. What the write path does enforce is a set of rules on the labels object itself, at most 64 keys, no key in the reserved gpuworks.ai namespace or any subdomain of it, a key grammar check and a value check for length and control characters (internal/server/nodelabel/nodelabel.go:128-142, reached from store/node_labels.go both before the write and again inside the transaction), and those rules are violated for real here rather than described. The refusals are driven over a node that already stores team=alpha, which is what makes the preservation assertion mean something: the earlier refusals in this case all ran against an empty label map, so requiring the map to still be empty compared one empty map with another and could not fail whatever the product did with a rejected write. With a value in place, a reserved key and a reserved subdomain key each answer 400 and an independent GET afterwards returns exactly team=alpha both times, so the refused write lost nothing. The corrected save from the same dialog then answers 200, its body is exactly {'labels': {'team': 'alpha'}}, and the independent read-back agrees, so the error clears and the submission can be made again. One rule deliberately is not used as the conflict: the 256-byte value limit, because the form's own maxLength stops a longer value from ever being submitted, so refusing it would only prove that the input was clipped. The browser side is checked with it: exactly one resource-400 console line is allowed per recorded refusal, the count taken from the refusals actually recorded rather than a fixed number, and every other console error still fails the case.
checklist_items.5.3: The multi-select search filters candidates to team=alpha, reports the no-result state for a missing term, selector search restoration after clearing remains MISSING
checklist_items.5.4: The label filter has a clear control. After team=alpha is selected, Escape closes the menu and the labeled node stays the only row. Hovering the filter shows the clear control. Clicking it removes team=alpha, the selection is empty, both rows return, and the independent GET /api/v1/nodes returns both nodes
checklist_items.10.2: Search covers partial, exact, missing and cleared queries with independent hit/exclusion sets and totals
checklist_items.12.1: Edit labels on the node row opens one dialog named by the labels title, and the add-label control is the visible business control
checklist_items.12.2: The row menu and labels modal open inside the 1440x900 viewport; the modal container and Save button are reachable
checklist_items.12.3: Default focus is inside the labels dialog. Tab and Shift+Tab each cycle across at least two controls and never leave the dialog
checklist_items.12.6: covered: While the label PUT is held the footer Save shows the loading state and a second click sends no further save; the 502 keeps the team and alpha draft and shows the server reason; the later 200 matches the reloaded row and the independent GET
checklist_items.2.7: A label value is free text, so it can carry markup. '' is written through the real labels PUT, and the independent GET confirms the server holds that exact string. The node list row renders each label as key=value text, so the case requires the literal 'team=' to be visible as text and requires that no img[src=x] element exists on the page. The plain value is restored afterwards so the rest of the case reads what it seeded. Proven by mutation: rendering the cell tag text with dangerouslySetInnerHTML in CellTags makes the case fail. While adding this the case turned out to be red on its own for an unrelated reason - the form refuses a whitespace-only label key (whitespace: true in NodeLabelsModal), so that check no longer sends a PUT - and that expectation was corrected in the same change.
checklist_items.2.1: The label editor's new row is registered before anything is typed, through exercise_label_field_inventory. Key and value are each located by their accessible name, the row is counted (exactly two textboxes), both are asserted empty with to_have_value(''), each placeholder is asserted separately from the value, the key is asserted required through aria-required while the value is asserted not required, and both maxLength limits are asserted (128 and 256). The add control is matched by its accessible name and asserted to be the dashed button, the row is asserted to have no unit and no spinner, and the whole sweep asserts that reading the row sent no request.
